name: v0.104.0
body:
# Better onboarding + maintenance Hey all, hope all americans are having a great Thanksgiving! 🦃 ## Onboarding We plan to work on the onboarding to help new Crush users. On this release we're shipping a first pass: * Before, we skipped the onboarding if any API were found on your ENV. Now we'll always show for new installations. * ENVs keep working as expected. If one was found for the chosen provider, Crush will just use it and won't ask you to paste an API key. * UI was enhanced the make it better use the space. List is taller and you can see more items at once. * Better mouse support (see below) ## Mouse support on models dialog You can use your mouse on the provider list dialog: scroll and select with click or choose with double-click. Because this is a shared component between the models dialog and onboarding, this improvement is available in both scenarios. ## Maintenance [Fantasy](https://github.com/charmbracelet/fantasy) was updated to the latest version to bring its bug fixes to Crush users. This includes fixes to vision (image attachments) on Gemini. ## Changelog ### New! * 1bc9788a8db244f2fb97ae91a49c4039de9da9df: feat: onboarding ux pass (#4444) (@andreynering) ### Fixed * 1396e64601fc8f8e47d18a716718c4cf7cbbcef6: fix(pinentry): keep the gpg passphrase hint out of terminal scrollback (@taciturnaxolotl) ### Other stuff * bfc989df81423894925216afffd90114580d0380: chore: auto-update files (@charmcli) * 1ad0adb2c08f64ce858ec8d4a40d0f8eb6bb6a2e: chore: update fantasy and catwalk (@andreynering) ---
Verifying the artifacts First, download the [`checksums.txt` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.104.0/checksums.txt) and the [`checksums.txt.sigstore.json` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.104.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json) files, for example, with `wget`: ```bash wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.104.0/checksums.txt' wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.104.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json' ``` Then, verify it using [`cosign`](https://github.com/sigstore/cosign): ```bash cosign verify-blob \ --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/\.github/workflows/(release|nightly)\.yml@' \ --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \ --bundle 'checksums.txt.sigstore.json' \ ./checksums.txt ``` If the output is `Verified OK`, you can safely use it to verify the checksums of other artifacts you downloaded from the release using `sha256sum`: ```bash sha256sum --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt ``` Done! You artifacts are now verified!
Thoughts? Questions? We love hearing from you. Feel free to reach out on [X](https://x.com/charmcli), [Discord](https://charm.land/discord), [Slack](https://charm.land/slack), [The Fediverse](https://mastodon.social/@charmcli), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/charm.land).
